name: 60544 · Plainfield, IL
findings: ZIP 60544 (Plainfield) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60544 (Plainfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60544 (Plainfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
